headline: Sri Lanka reached 114-3 at stumps on day two of the first Test in Rawalpindi on Tuesday, trailing Pakistan's 434-9 declared by 320 runs.

card.desc: Doosre din ke baad Sri Lanka 320 runs peeche hai.

caption:
Pehle Test mein Sri Lanka 114-3 par mushkil mein! 🏏
Dawn ke mutabiq Tuesday ko Rawalpindi mein doosre din ka khel kam roshni ki wajah se jaldi khatam ho gaya. Pakistan ke 434-9 (declare) ke jawab mein Sri Lanka ne 114-3 banaye aur abhi 320 runs peeche hai. Debut karne wale Saqib Khan ne 2 wickets aur Mohammad Abbas ne 1 wicket liya. Kamindu Mendis 40 aur captain Dhananjaya de Silva 22 runs par khel rahe hain.
Kya Pakistan yeh Test jeet jayega? Comment mein batayein 👇
